scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --workspace api" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.start:dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --workspace api" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.start:qa: concurrently -n API-QA,WEB-QA -c cyan,yellow "npm run start:qa --workspace api" "npm run dev:qa --workspace web"
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate --workspace api && npm run db:deploy --workspace api && npm run db:seed --workspace api
scripts.db:setup:qa: npm run prisma:generate --workspace api && npm run db:deploy:qa --workspace api && npm run db:seed:qa --workspace api
